mLocKeys.keySummary: Rek'Sai passively marks targets by damaging them. She can activate this ability to become briefly untargetable and lunge at a marked target for heavy damage based on their maximum health.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Rek'Sai targets an enemy damaged by her in the last @PreyMarkDuration@ seconds and then dives underground, becoming Untargetable. Moments later, she leaps unstoppably at her target, dealing <physicalDamage>@RBaseDamageCalc@ plus @PercentHealthDamage@% max Health physical damage</physicalDamage> and resets the cooldown of <keywordMajor>{{Spell_RekSaiW_Name}}</keywordMajor>.

<titleLeft>Marked as Prey</titleLeft><mainText>Rek'Sai can Void Rush this unit.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary:
Rek'Sai bites her target, dealing physical damage, or bonus true damage if she has max Fury.

While Burrowed, Rek'Sai creates a re-usable, long lasting tunnel. Enemies can destroy it by standing on top of either entrance.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: <keywordMajor>Unburrowed:</keywordMajor> Rek'Sai bites a target, dealing <physicalDamage>@spell.RekSaiE:BaseDamageCalculation@ physical damage</physicalDamage>. At max <keywordMajor>Fury</keywordMajor>, the bite deals <trueDamage>@spell.RekSaiE:EmpoweredDamageCalculation@ true damage</trueDamage> instead.

mLocKeys.keySummary:
Rek'Sai bites her target, dealing physical damage, or bonus true damage if she has max Fury.

While Burrowed, Rek'Sai creates a re-usable, long lasting tunnel. Enemies can destroy it by standing on top of either entrance.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: <keywordMajor>Unburrowed:</keywordMajor> Rek'Sai bites a target, dealing <physicalDamage>@spell.RekSaiE:BaseDamageCalculation@ physical damage</physicalDamage>. At max <keywordMajor>Fury</keywordMajor>, the bite deals <trueDamage>@spell.RekSaiE:EmpoweredDamageCalculation@ true damage</trueDamage> instead.

<keywordMajor>Burrowed:</keywordMajor> Rek'Sai tunnels forward, leaving two connected tunnel entrances for @spell.RekSaiE:TunnelDurationMinutes@ minutes. Rek'Sai can click on one of the entrances to tunnel to the other one, and tunnels each have a @spell.RekSaiE:TunnelReuseCooldown@ second Cooldown between uses. Rek'Sai can have up to @spell.RekSaiE:MaximumTunnels@ tunnels at once.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Tunnels can be destroyed by enemies standing on them.</rules>

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Un-burrow</titleLeft> <mainText>This unit is immune to Rek'Sai's Un-burrow for a short time.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Fury of the Xer'Sai</titleLeft> <mainText>Rek'Sai is regenerating Health.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

Fury of the Xer'SaiWhile Rek'Sai is un-burrowed, her basic attacks and spells generate 25 Fury.

Burrowing consumes Fury over 3 seconds to restore up to @f2@ Health.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Rek'Sai generates Fury by Attacking and hitting with basic Abilities. She consumes this Fury while Burrowed to restore health.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Rek'Sai generates @FuryFromAttacks@ Fury when she Attacks and @FuryFromAbilities@ Fury from Abilities.

While Burrowed, she consumes her Fury to restore up to @HealAmount@ Health over @HealDuration@ seconds, increasing with level.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
{{Spell_RekSaiPassive_Tooltip}}

Rek'sai will not consume Fury while at full Health.
Rek'sai loses 20 Fury per second after @PauseDuration@ seconds of not generating any.
Rek'Sai generates @FuryMinionMod*100@% Fury with Attacks against minions.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Queen's Wrath</titleLeft> <mainText>Rek'Sai's next 3 basic attacks deal bonus Physical Damage to all nearby enemies.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary:
Rek'Sai's next 3 basic attacks deal bonus Physical Damage to nearby enemies.

While Burrowed, Rek'Sai launches a burst of void-charged earth that damages and reveals enemies hit.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: <keywordMajor>Unburrowed:</keywordMajor> Rek'Sai's next 3 Attacks within @BuffDuration@ seconds gain <attackSpeed>@AttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed</attackSpeed> and deal an additional <physicalDamage>@TotalDamageTooltip@ physical damage</physicalDamage> to nearby enemies. Attacks refresh the duration of this Ability.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>The bonus damage can critically strike the primary target.</rules>

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Queen's Wrath</titleLeft> <mainText>Rek'Sai's next 3 basic attacks deal bonus Physical Damage to all nearby enemies.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

While Burrowed, Rek'Sai launches a burst of void-charged earth that damages and reveals enemies hit.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: <keywordMajor>Unburrowed:</keywordMajor> Rek'Sai's next 3 Attacks within @BuffDuration@ seconds gain <attackSpeed>@AttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed</attackSpeed> and deal an additional <physicalDamage>@TotalDamageTooltip@ physical damage</physicalDamage> to nearby enemies. Attacks refresh the duration of this Ability.

<keywordMajor>Burrowed:</keywordMajor> Rek'Sai launches a burst of void-charged earth that explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing <magicDamage>@spell.RekSaiQ:BurrowDamageTooltip@ magic damage</magicDamage> in a small area. It also reveals non-stealthed enemies for @spell.RekSaiQ:BurrowedDebuffDuration@ seconds. If it hits a Champion, it generates <keywordMajor>@spell.RekSaiPassive:FuryFromAbilities@ Fury</keywordMajor>.

mLocKeys.keySummary:
Rek'Sai burrows into the ground, gaining new abilities and increased Move Speed. Her vision range is reduced and she cannot use basic attacks.

While Burrowed, Rek'Sai may cast Unburrow to knock up and damage nearby enemies.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: <keywordMajor>Unburrowed:</keywordMajor> Rek'Sai burrows into the ground, gaining access to new Abilities but cannot Attack. She gains <speed>@BurrowedMoveSpeed@ Move Speed</speed>, @VisionRadiusMod*-100@% reduced vision range, and nearby enemies that move and are otherwise unseen will have their positions revealed to Rek'sai and her allies.

mLocKeys.keySummary:
Rek'Sai burrows into the ground, gaining new abilities and increased Move Speed. Her vision range is reduced and she cannot use basic attacks.

While Burrowed, Rek'Sai may cast Unburrow to knock up and damage nearby enemies.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: <keywordMajor>Unburrowed:</keywordMajor> Rek'Sai burrows into the ground, gaining access to new Abilities but cannot Attack. She gains <speed>@BurrowedMoveSpeed@ Move Speed</speed>, @VisionRadiusMod*-100@% reduced vision range, and nearby enemies that move and are otherwise unseen will have their positions revealed to Rek'sai and her allies.

<keywordMajor>Burrowed:</keywordMajor> Rek'Sai unburrows, dealing <magicDamage>@spell.RekSaiW:UnburrowDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> to all nearby enemies, <status>Knocking Up</status> her primary target, nearby Champions, and nearby Large Monsters for @spell.RekSaiW:KnockupDuration@s. Enemies can only be <status>Knocked Up</status> by this Ability once every @spell.RekSaiW:KnockupImmunity@ seconds.
